podcast.body: Released in 1974, "Rock and Roll Survivors" was the album that featured Fanny's most successful single, "Butter Boy." The album was a highlight of their career and contained the track that received significant attention. "Their most successful hit was from 1974, an album called Rock and Roll Survivors."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
